本.zh: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。
本.pinyin: Wǒ zuò wán wǒ de gōng kè hòu jiù dú zhè běn shū
本.en: I read the book after I had finished my homework.
本.es: En cuanto terminé de hacer los deberes, me puse a leer este libro.

本.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ néng jiè duō jiǔ
本.en: How long can I borrow this book?
本.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo puedo tomar prestado este libro?

本.zh: 我用两千日元买了这本书。
本.pinyin: Wǒ yòng liǎng qiān rì yuán mǎi le zhè běn shū
本.en: I paid two thousand yen for the book.
本.es: Compré el libro por doscientos yenes.

本.en: How many books do you have?

听.pinyin: Nǐ zài tīng wǒ shuō ma
听.en: Do you hear what I'm saying?

听.zh: 要我解释给你听是不可能的。
听.pinyin: Yào wǒ jiě shì gěi nǐ tīng shì bù kě néng de
听.en: It's impossible for me to explain it to you.

听.zh: 我听过这首歌的法语版。
听.pinyin: Wǒ tīng guo zhè shǒu gē de fǎ yǔ bǎn
听.en: I heard the song sung in French.
听.es: Oí esa canción cantada en francés.

听.zh: 我没见过也没听过这样的事。
听.pinyin: Wǒ méi jiàn guo yě méi tīng guo zhè yàng de shì
听.en: I have neither seen nor heard of such a thing.
听.es: Nunca he visto o escuchado algo así.

桌子.pinyin: Wǒ zào le yī zhāng mù zhuō zi
桌子.en: I made a desk of wood.

桌子.zh: 他给我们做了一张桌子和两把长椅。
桌子.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ men zuò le yī zhāng zhuō zi hé liǎng bǎ cháng yǐ
桌子.en: He made a desk and two benches for us.
桌子.es: Hizo una mesa y dos bancos para nosotros.

桌子.zh: 先生，您把您的打火机留在桌子上了。
桌子.pinyin: Xiān sheng nín bǎ nín de dǎ huǒ jī liú zài zhuō zi shàng le
桌子.en: Sir, you have left your lighter on the table.
桌子.es: Señor, se ha dejado el mechero sobre la mesa.

桌子.pinyin: Tā bǎ qiān bǐ fàng zhuō zi shàng le
桌子.en: He put down the pencil on the desk.
桌子.es: Puso el lápiz sobre el escritorio.

水果.zh: 我父亲没有吃很多的水果。
水果.pinyin: Wǒ fù qīn méi yǒu chī hěn duō de shuǐ guǒ
水果.en: My father does not eat much fruit.
水果.es: Mi padre no come muchas frutas.

水果.zh: 新鲜的水果对你的健康有益。
水果.pinyin: Xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ duì nǐ de jiàn kāng yǒu yì
水果.en: Fresh fruit is good for your health.
水果.es: La fruta fresca es buena para la salud.

水果.zh: 我找到一个买水果很便宜的地方。
水果.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo dào yī ge mǎi shuǐ guǒ hěn pián yi de dì fang
水果.en: I found out where to buy fruit cheaply.

水果.pinyin: Shèn má shuǐ guǒ shì hóng sè de

第一.zh: 我对他的第一印象果然没有错。
第一.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de dì yī yìn xiàng guǒ rán méi yǒu cuò
第一.en: My first impression of him proved to be correct.
第一.es: Mi primera impresión acerca de él resultó ser correcta.

第一.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
第一.pinyin: Zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
第一.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
第一.es: Dudar de sí mismo es la primera señal de inteligencia.

第一.zh: 我匆匆忙忙，为的是能赶上第一班火车。
第一.pinyin: Wǒ cōng cōng máng máng wèi de shì néng gǎn shàng dì yī bān huǒ chē
第一.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.
第一.es: Me apuré para alcanzar el primer tren.

第一.zh: 我在想哪个跑步运动员会跑第一。
第一.pinyin: Wǒ zài xiǎng nǎ ge pǎo bù yùn dòng yuán huì páo dì yī
第一.en: I wonder which of the runners will come first.
第一.es: Me pregunto cuál de los corredores llegará primero.

完成.pinyin: Wǒ chà bu duō wán chéng le

完成.zh: 如果不是因为有你的帮助，我不可能完成了这个工作。
完成.pinyin: Rú guǒ bù shì yīn wèi yǒu nǐ de bāng zhù wǒ bù kě néng wán chéng le zhè ge gōng zuò
完成.en: If it had not been for your help, I couldn't have completed the work.
完成.es: Si no hubiera sido por tu ayuda, no podría haber completado el trabajo.

完成.zh: 给我们工具，我们会完成工作。
完成.pinyin: Gěi wǒ men gōng jù wǒ men huì wán chéng gōng zuò
完成.en: Give us the tools, and we'll finish the job.
完成.es: Danos las herramientas, y terminaremos el trabajo.

完成.zh: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。
完成.pinyin: Wǒ yòng le bǐ wǒ yù qī gèng cháng de shí jiān lái wán chéng zuò yè
完成.en: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
完成.es: La tarea me tomó más tiempo del que esperaba.

马.pinyin: Mǎ shì zhǒng hěn yǒu yòng de dòng wù

马.zh: 可以让我骑一会儿这匹马吗？
马.pinyin: Kě yǐ ràng wǒ qí yī huìr zhè pǐ mǎ ma
马.en: Can I ride this horse for a while?
马.es: ¿Puedo montar a este caballo un rato?

马.zh: 所有的马都是动物, 但并非所有的动物都是马。
马.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu de mǎ dōu shì dòng wù dàn bìng fēi suǒ yǒu de dòng wù dōu shì mǎ
马.en: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.
马.es: Todos los caballos son animales, pero no todos los animales son caballos.

马.pinyin: Mǎ dí lā shì jiǔ de míng zi
马.en: Madeira is the name of a wine.
马.es: "Madeira" es el nombre de un vino.

面包.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ yī kuài miàn bāo
面包.en: Please give me a piece of bread.
面包.es: Dame un trozo de pan por favor.

面包.pinyin: Wǒ men chī miàn bāo jiā huáng yóu

面包.zh: 今天早上，我吃了面包夹黄油。
面包.pinyin: Jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ chī le miàn bāo jiā huáng yóu
面包.en: I ate bread and butter this morning.
面包.es: Esta mañana, he comido pan con mantequilla.

面包.zh: 面包是用面粉和水做的，有时还会加入发酵粉。
面包.pinyin: Miàn bāo shì yòng miàn fěn hé shuǐ zuò de yǒu shí hái huì jiā rù fā jiào fěn
面包.en: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.
面包.es: El pan es hecho con harina y agua y en ocasiones se le agrega levadura.

搬.pinyin: Nǐ bān bù dòng nà tái gāng qín

搬.zh: 你搬的地方真是好地段，现在大家是看上地段和房型。
搬.pinyin: Nǐ bān de dì fang zhēn shi hǎo dì duàn xiàn zài dà jiā shì kàn shàng dì duàn hé fáng xíng
搬.en: The place you moved to is in such a good spot. Nowadays, everyone's looking for a good location and architecture for their house.

搬.zh: 在这二百年来，有很多人从农村搬到了市区居住。
搬.pinyin: Zài zhè èr bǎi nián lái yǒu hěn duō rén cóng nóng cūn bān dào le shì qū jū zhù
搬.en: This movement from rural to urban areas has been going on for over two hundred years.

搬.zh: 因为今天明天我休息，所以趁机会快点搬好它。
搬.pinyin: Yīn wèi jīn tiān míng tiān wǒ xiū xi suǒ yǐ chèn jī huì kuài diǎn bān hǎo tā
搬.en: I don't have to go to work today and tomorrow, so I will use the opportunity to quickly finish moving it.

舒服.zh: 他们告诉我吃完这个药我就会觉得舒服一点。
舒服.pinyin: Tā men gào su wǒ chī wán zhè ge yào wǒ jiù huì jué de shū fu yī diǎn
舒服.en: I was told I would feel better after this medicine.
舒服.es: Me dijeron que me sentiría un poco mejor si tomaba este medicamento.

舒服.pinyin: Zhè shì zhāng shū fu de yǐ zi
Zhè zhāng yǐ zi hěn shū fu

舒服.zh: 过去两天我觉得不太舒服。
舒服.pinyin: Guò qù liǎng tiān wǒ jué de bù tài shū fu
舒服.en: I've been feeling poorly for the last couple of days.

地图.pinyin: Wǒ zài lǚ xíng zhōng yòng le dì tú
地图.en: I made use of the maps during my journey.
地图.es: He utilizado mapas durante mi viaje.

地图.zh: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。
地图.pinyin: Dì tú bāng zhù wǒ men zhī dào suǒ zài de wèi zhi
地图.en: A map helps us to know where we are.
地图.es: Un mapa nos ayuda a saber dónde estamos.

地图.pinyin: Zhè shì yī fú dì tú

地图.zh: 地图上的红线代表铁路。
地图.pinyin: Dì tú shàng de hóng xiàn dài biǎo tiě lù
地图.en: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
地图.es: La línea roja en el mapa representa una vía férrea.

司机.zh: 他们的父亲是一个计程车司机。
司机.pinyin: Tā men de fù qīn shì yī ge jì chéng chē sī jī
司机.en: Their father is a taxi driver.

司机.pinyin: Tā shì chū zū chē sī jī

司机.zh: 巴士司机有责任保护乘客的安全。
司机.pinyin: Bā shì sī jī yǒu zé rèn bǎo hù chéng kè de ān quán
司机.en: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
司机.es: Un conductor de autobús es responsable de la seguridad de sus pasajeros.

上网.zh: 那两个人不是因为过于上网而忽视他们的孩子。
上网.pinyin: Nà liǎng gè rén bù shì yīn wèi guò yú shàng wǎng ér hū shì tā men de hái zi
上网.en: Those people did not neglect their child because they used the Internet too much.
上网.es: Aquellas personas no desatendían a su hijo debido a que pasaran demasiado tiempo con Internet.

上网.zh: 过于上网不是跟医学或精神病有关的事情。
上网.pinyin: Guò yú shàng wǎng bù shì gēn yī xué huò jīng shén bìng yǒu guān de shì qing
上网.en: Excessive use of the Internet is not a medical or psychiatric issue.
上网.es: Un uso excesivo de Internet no es una cuestión médica o psiquiátrica.

冬.pinyin: Zhè shì gè jìng mì de dōng yè
冬.en: It was a calm winter evening.

冬.zh: 中国乒乓球队进行了一个月的封闭式冬训。
冬.pinyin: Zhōng guó pīng pāng qiú duì jìn xíng le yī ge yuè de fēng bì shì dōng xùn
冬.en: The China National Table Tennis Team had a month's closed training in winter.

冬.zh: 一年有四个季节 : 春、夏、秋、冬。
冬.pinyin: Yī nián yǒu sì gè jì jié chūn xià qiū dōng
冬.en: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

许多.pinyin: Tā de róng mào gǎi biàn le xǔ duō
许多.en: He's changed a lot in his looks.

许多.zh: 十年后，我们的城市将改变许多。
许多.pinyin: Shí nián hòu wǒ men de chéng shì jiāng gǎi biàn xǔ duō
许多.en: In ten years our town will change a lot.
许多.es: En diez años nuestro pueblo cambiará mucho.

许多.zh: 许多人毫无目的地随波逐流。
许多.pinyin: Xǔ duō rén háo wú mù dì dì suí bō zhú liú
许多.en: Many people drift through life without a purpose.
许多.es: Mucha gente vaga por la vida sin una meta.

许多.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。
许多.pinyin: Xǔ duō rén zài gōng yè chéng shì gōng zuò
许多.en: Many people work in industrial towns.
许多.es: Muchas personas trabajan en ciudades industriales.

困难.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。
困难.pinyin: Wǒ biān yì zhè ge chéng xù yǒu xiē kùn nan
困难.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
困难.es: Tengo problemas para compilar este programa.

困难.zh: 生活很困难，但我更坚强。
困难.pinyin: Shēng huó hěn kùn nan dàn wǒ gèng jiān qiáng
困难.en: Life is hard, but I am harder.
困难.es: La vida es dura, pero yo soy más duro.

困难.zh: 俄罗斯面临着严重的财政困难。
困难.pinyin: É luó sī miàn lín zhe yán zhòng de cái zhèng kùn nan
困难.en: Russia is facing great financial difficulties.
困难.es: Rusia está enfrentando una gran dificultad financiera.

困难.zh: 如果我是你，我会在这种困难的情况下做同样的事。
困难.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ shì nǐ wǒ huì zài zhè zhǒng kùn nan de qíng kuàng xià zuò tóng yàng de shì
困难.en: If I were you, I would have done the same thing in such a difficult situation.

只要.zh: 只要有你在我的身边，我就别无他求了。
只要.pinyin: Zhǐ yào yǒu nǐ zài wǒ de shēn biān wǒ jiù bié wú tā qiú le
只要.en: If you are by my side, I don't need anything else.
只要.es: Si estás a mi lado no necesito nada más.

只要.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。
只要.pinyin: Zhǐ yào tīng dào zhè shǒu gē wǒ jiù huì xiǎng qǐ tā men de xiào róng
只要.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
只要.es: Siempre que oigo esta canción, pienso en su sonrisa.

只要.zh: 你只要在这里写下你的姓名和地址就行了。
只要.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ yào zài zhè lǐ xiě xià nǐ de xìng míng hé dì zhǐ jiù xíng le
只要.en: All you have to do is to write your name and address here.
只要.es: Lo único que tienes que hacer es escribir aquí tu nombre y dirección.

只要.zh: 只要你微笑，我就会快乐。
只要.pinyin: Zhǐ yào nǐ wēi xiào wǒ jiù huì kuài lè
只要.en: If you smile, I'll be happy.
只要.es: Si tú sonríes, yo soy feliz.

转.pinyin: Shì jiè bù shì wéi zhe nǐ zhuǎn de
转.en: The world doesn't revolve around you.
转.es: El mundo no gira alrededor tuyo.

转.pinyin: Tiān tū rán zhuǎn yīn le
转.en: All of a sudden the sky became overcast.

转.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ zhuǎn xiǎo shēng yī diǎn ma
Hū rán tiān qì zhuǎn wèi duō yún
转.en: All of a sudden, it became cloudy.

缺点.zh: 要变得完美，她就是少了一个缺点。
缺点.pinyin: Yào biàn de wán měi tā jiù shì shǎo le yī ge quē diǎn
缺点.en: To be perfect she lacked just one defect.
缺点.es: Para ser perfecta sólo le faltaba un defecto.

缺点.zh: 虽然她有些缺点，但我始终还是爱她。
缺点.pinyin: Suī rán tā yǒu xiē quē diǎn dàn wǒ shǐ zhōng hái shi ài tā
缺点.en: She has faults, but I love her none the less.
缺点.es: Ella tiene sus defecto, pero aun así la amo.

缺点.zh: 虽然她有许多缺点，但我却情不自禁地爱著她。
缺点.pinyin: Suī rán tā yǒu xǔ duō quē diǎn dàn wǒ què qíng bù zì jīn de ài zhe tā
缺点.en: I cannot help loving her in spite of her many faults.
缺点.es: No puedo dejar de amarla a pesar de sus defectos.

缺点.pinyin: Tā de quē diǎn ràng wǒ gèng ài tā
缺点.en: I love her all the more for her faults.

客厅.pinyin: Wǒ xīn jiā de kè tīng hěn kuān chang
客厅.en: The living room in my new house is very large.
客厅.es: La sala de mi casa nueva es muy amplia.

客厅.zh: 她不在厨房里，也不在客厅里。
客厅.pinyin: Tā bù zài chú fáng lǐ yě bù zài kè tīng lǐ
客厅.en: She is neither in the kitchen nor in the living room.
客厅.es: No está ni en la cocina ni en la sala.

客厅.pinyin: Nǐ zài kè tīng chī fàn ma
客厅.en: Do you eat in the living room?

客厅.pinyin: Kè tīng de jiā jù fēng gé xiàn dài
客厅.en: The living room furniture was modern in style.
客厅.es: Los muebles del salón eran de estilo moderno.

自信.zh: 约翰对自己的能力很有自信。
自信.pinyin: Yuē hàn duì zì jǐ de néng lì hěn yǒu zì xìn
自信.en: John has confidence in his ability.
自信.es: John tiene confianza en su capacidad.

自信.zh: 自信是伟大事业的第一要素。
自信.pinyin: Zì xìn shì wěi dà shì yè de dì yī yào sù
自信.en: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.

自信.pinyin: Nǎ lái nà me dà de zì xìn a
自信.en: Where did all that self-confidence come from?

自信.pinyin: Zì liàn shì wèi le gèng zì xìn

理想.zh: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
理想.pinyin: Hǎi tān shì yī ge gōng hái zi men wán lè de lǐ xiǎng chǎng suǒ
理想.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
理想.es: La playa es un lugar ideal para que jueguen los niños.

理想.zh: 他被证实是个理想丈夫。
理想.pinyin: Tā bèi zhèng shí shì gè lǐ xiǎng zhàng fu
理想.en: He proved to be an ideal husband.

理想.pinyin: Nǐ shì wǒ de lǐ xiǎng qíng rén
理想.en: You're the girl of my dreams.

理想.zh: 他表明自己是一个理想的丈夫。
理想.pinyin: Tā biǎo míng zì jǐ shì yī ge lǐ xiǎng de zhàng fu
理想.en: He's making it clear that he's an ideal husband.

难受.pinyin: Tā sǐ le wǒ zhēn nán shòu
难受.en: I am very sad that he has died.

难受.pinyin: Wǒ nán shòu sān zhōu le
难受.en: I was sore for three weeks.

难受.pinyin: Wǒ shēng bìng le hěn nán shòu

作用.zh: 他的忠告没起到太大的作用。
作用.pinyin: Tā de zhōng gào méi qǐ dào tài dà de zuò yòng
作用.es: Su consejo no sirvió de mucho.

作用.zh: 实际上，网络的作用有着无数的多种多样的。
作用.pinyin: Shí jì shàng wǎng luò de zuò yòng yǒu zhe wú shù de duō zhǒng duō yàng de
作用.en: In fact, there are countless, varied uses for the Internet.

作用.zh: 电视在日常生活中起着重要的作用。
作用.pinyin: Diàn shì zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng qǐ zhuó zhòng yào de zuò yòng
作用.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.
作用.es: La televisión ocupa un lugar importante en el diario vivir.

作用.pinyin: Zhè shì gè zuò yòng qiáng liè de yào
作用.en: This medicine has a strong effect.

导游.pinyin: Wǒ zài dōng jīng zuò dǎo yóu
导游.en: I'm a tour guide in Tokyo.

导游.pinyin: Wǒ wèi nǐ chōng dāng dǎo yóu
导游.en: I'll act as a guide for you.

导游.zh: 他们和一个导游一起出发，只是为了以防迷路。
导游.pinyin: Tā men hé yī ge dǎo yóu yī qǐ chū fā zhǐ shì wèi le yǐ fáng mí lù
导游.en: They set out with a guide just in case they lost their way.

导游.pinyin: Zhè běn dǎo yóu cè zi huò xǔ huì duì nǐ de lǚ xíng yǒu bāng zhù
导游.en: This guidebook might be of use to you on your trip.

抬.zh: 她累得连脚也抬不起来了。
抬.pinyin: Tā lèi de lián jiǎo yě tái bù qǐ lai le
抬.en: She was so tired that she couldn't walk.
抬.es: Ella estaba tan cansada que no podía andar.

抬.pinyin: Zán bǎ jiā jù tái shàng lóu ba

于是.zh: 艾伦太累了，于是早早地上床睡觉了。
于是.pinyin: Ài lún tài lèi le yú shì zǎo zǎo dì shang chuáng shuì jiào le
于是.en: Ellen was so tired that she went to bed early.
于是.es: Ellen estaba tan cansada que se fue temprano a la cama.

于是.zh: 于是出现了一个问题，哪里能找我们需要的机器。
于是.pinyin: Yú shì chū xiàn le yī ge wèn tí nǎ lǐ néng zhǎo wǒ men xū yào de jī qì
于是.en: Then arose the question of where we were to get the necessary machinery.

于是.zh: 别人建议我坐飞机而不是坐船去，于是我选择了坐飞机。
于是.pinyin: Bié ren jiàn yì wǒ zuò fēi jī ér bù shì zuò chuán qù yú shì wǒ xuǎn zé le zuò fēi jī
于是.en: I was told to go not by boat but by plane, which advice I followed.

于是.zh: 他觉得她说得很有道理，于是接受了她的建议。
于是.pinyin: Tā jué de tā shuō de hěn yǒu dào li yú shì jiē shòu le tā de jiàn yì
于是.en: He thought she spoke reasonably, so he accepted her suggestion.

如何.pinyin: Tā jiāo wǒ rú hé yóu yǒng
如何.en: She taught me how to swim.

如何.zh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
如何.pinyin: Gōng chéng shī gào su wǒ men rú hé shǐ yòng jī qì
如何.en: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
如何.es: El ingeniero nos dijo cómo usar la máquina.

如何.pinyin: Tā zhī dào rú hé zuò shōu yīn jī
如何.en: He knows how to make a radio.
如何.es: Él sabe cómo hacer un radio.

如何.pinyin: Nǐ duì měi guó yìn xiàng rú hé
如何.en: What's your impression of the United States?

到达.zh: 走了五分钟，我们就到达了公园。
到达.pinyin: Zǒu le wǔ fēn zhōng wǒ men jiù dào dá le gōng yuán
到达.en: Five minutes' walk brought us to the park.
到达.es: Caminando cinco minutos llegamos al parque.

到达.zh: 我天黑之前到达了村庄。
到达.pinyin: Wǒ tiān hēi zhī qián dào dá le cūn zhuāng
到达.en: I arrived at the village before dark.
到达.es: Llegué al pueblo antes de que oscureciera.

到达.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān dào dá dōng jīng
Tā men zhōng yú dào dá le shān dǐng
到达.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
到达.es: Al fin ellos llegaron a la cima de la montaña.

咬.zh: 如果你咬我，我就咬回来。
咬.pinyin: Rú guǒ nǐ yǎo wǒ wǒ jiù yǎo huí lai
咬.en: If you bite me, I'll bite back.
咬.es: Si me muerdes te devolveré el mordisco.

咬.pinyin: Nǐ de gǒu yǎo rén ma

咬.zh: 你真走运，因为他没咬你。
咬.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn zǒu yùn yīn wèi tā méi yǎo nǐ
咬.en: You're lucky because he didn't bite you.
咬.es: Has tenido suerte de que no te haya mordido.

咬.zh: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳。
咬.pinyin: Yī cháo bèi shé yǎo shí nián pà jǐng shéng
咬.es: Gato escaldado del agua fría huye.

呼吸.zh: 我的鼻子没办法呼吸了。
呼吸.pinyin: Wǒ de bí zi méi bàn fǎ hū xī le
呼吸.en: I can't breathe through my nose.
呼吸.es: No puedo respirar por la nariz.

呼吸.pinyin: Wǒ bǐng zhù le hū xī děng dài zhe
呼吸.en: I held my breath and waited.

呼吸.pinyin: Tā zhǐ zhù le hū xī

现实.zh: 现实和幻想是很难区分的。
现实.pinyin: Xiàn shí hé huàn xiǎng shì hěn nán qū fēn de
现实.en: Reality and fantasy are hard to distinguish.
现实.es: La realidad y la fantasía son difíciles de distinguir.

现实.zh: 你这些想法是与现实脱节的。
现实.pinyin: Nǐ zhè xiē xiǎng fǎ shì yǔ xiàn shí tuō jié de
现实.en: Your opinions are out of touch with reality.

现实.zh: 从现实的角度看，他的计划有很多缺点。
现实.pinyin: Cóng xiàn shí de jiǎo dù kàn tā de jì huà yǒu hěn duō quē diǎn
现实.en: From the practical point of view, there are many shortcomings in his plan.

自私.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge zì sī de rén

自私.zh: 也许你说得对。我一直都很自私。
自私.pinyin: Yě xǔ nǐ shuō de duì wǒ yī zhí dōu hěn zì sī
自私.en: Perhaps you are right, I have been selfish.
自私.es: Quizás tengas razón, fui un egoísta.

自私.pinyin: Tā hěn fán rén ér qiě hěn zì sī

表面.zh: 你要学的是实实在在的技能，而不单是表面的知识。
表面.pinyin: Nǐ yào xué de shì shí shí zài zài de jì néng ér bù dān shì biǎo miàn de zhī shi
表面.en: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
表面.es: Tienes que adquirir verdaderas destrezas, no simplemente conocimientos superficiales.

表面.pinyin: Guāng kàn biǎo miàn shì bù zú gòu de
表面.en: All that glitters is not gold.
表面.es: No es oro todo lo que reluce.

表面.zh: 地球的表面有七成是水。
表面.pinyin: Dì qiú de biǎo miàn yǒu qī chéng shì shuǐ
表面.en: The surface of the earth is 70% water.
表面.es: La superficie de la tierra es 70% agua.

表面.zh: 地球的表面约有三分之一是陆地。
表面.pinyin: Dì qiú de biǎo miàn yāo yǒu sān fēn zhī yī shì lù dì
表面.en: About one third of the earth's surface is land.
表面.es: Aproximadamente un tercio de la superficie de la Tierra es suelo firme.

风景.zh: 我们望著这美丽的风景。
风景.pinyin: Wǒ men wàng zhe zhè měi lì de fēng jǐng
风景.en: We gazed at the beautiful scenery.

风景.zh: 他们欣赏了美丽的风景。
风景.pinyin: Tā men xīn shǎng le měi lì de fēng jǐng
Zhè xiē shù dǎng zhù le fēng jǐng

风景.zh: 瑞士以它的风景优美而闻名。
风景.pinyin: Ruì shì yǐ tā de fēng jǐng yōu měi ér wén míng
风景.en: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
风景.es: Suiza es famosa por su belleza escénica.

公开.zh: 公开此事会影响我们的销售，所以我们将忽略它一次。
公开.pinyin: Gōng kāi cǐ shì huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ men de xiāo shòu suǒ yǐ wǒ men jiāng hū lüè tā yī cì
公开.en: Making this matter public would have an effect on our sales, so we're going to overlook it this once.
公开.es: Hacer este asunto público tendría efecto sobre las ventas, así que vamos a pasarlo por alto por esta vez.

公开.zh: 你很快就会习惯在公开场合讲话了。
公开.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn zài gōng kāi chǎng hé jiǎng huà le
公开.en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
公开.es: Pronto te acostumbrarás a hablar en público.

公开.zh: 玛丽亚不喜欢在公开场合说话。
公开.pinyin: Mǎ lì yà bù xǐ huan zài gōng kāi chǎng hé shuō huà
公开.en: Maria doesn't like speaking in public.
公开.es: A María no le gusta hablar en público.

公开.zh: 在公开场合开你老板的玩笑是无礼的。
公开.pinyin: Zài gōng kāi chǎng hé kāi nǐ lǎo bǎn de wán xiào shì wú lǐ de
公开.en: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.

硬.pinyin: Zhè ge chuáng diàn hěn yìng
硬.en: This is a very hard mattress.

硬.zh: 地上覆盖着积雪，冻成了又硬又厚的壳。
硬.pinyin: Dì shang fù gài zhe jī xuě dòng chéng le yòu yìng yòu hòu de ké
硬.en: The snow lay on the ground, frozen into a thick, hard crust.
硬.es: La nieve se acumuló en el suelo, creando un gruesa y dura capa de hielo.

硬.zh: 马麻，我的鸡鸡硬到不行。
硬.pinyin: Mǎ má wǒ de jī jī yìng dào bù xíng

显得.zh: 她穿著高跟鞋，这样显得更高一些。
显得.pinyin: Tā chuān zhuó gāo gēn xié zhè yàng xiǎn de gèng gāo yī xiē
显得.en: She wears high heels to make herself look taller.
显得.es: Lleva zapatos de tacón para parecer más alta.

显得.zh: 我们小时候，所有的一切对我们来说都显得那么大。。。
显得.pinyin: Wǒ men xiǎo shí hou suǒ yǒu de yī qiè duì wǒ men lái shuō dōu xiǎn de nà me dà
显得.en: When we are small, everything seems so big.

显得.zh: 当他问起是谁打破了窗户时，所有的男生都显得很无辜。
显得.pinyin: Dāng tā wèn qǐ shì shéi dǎ pò le chuāng hu shí suǒ yǒu de nán shēng dōu xiǎn de hěn wú gū
显得.en: When he asked who had broken the window, all the boys put on an air of innocence.

显得.zh: 一个人能否在不显得傲慢的情况下保持诚实？
显得.pinyin: Yī gè rén néng fǒu zài bù xiǎn de ào màn de qíng kuàng xià bǎo chí chéng shí
显得.en: Can one be honest without appearing arrogant?

全面.zh: 全面罢工瘫痪了整个国家。
全面.pinyin: Quán miàn bà gōng tān huàn le zhěng gè guó jiā
全面.en: The general strike paralyzed the whole country.
全面.es: La huelga general paralizó todo el país.

全面.zh: 我想去医院做一个全面的检查。
全面.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn zuò yī ge quán miàn de jiǎn chá
全面.en: I want to go to the hospital to get a complete check-up.

潮湿.zh: 炎热潮湿的天气使我们变得懒散。
潮湿.pinyin: Yán rè cháo shī de tiān qì shǐ wǒ men biàn de lǎn sǎn
潮湿.en: Hot and humid weather makes us lazy.

潮湿.zh: 这里的夏天很潮湿，另外，冬天很干燥。
潮湿.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de xià tiān hěn cháo shī lìng wài dōng tiān hěn gān zào
潮湿.en: It gets very humid here in the summer. In the winter, on the other hand, it gets very dry.

潮湿.zh: 台湾的夏天很潮湿闷热。
潮湿.pinyin: Tái wān de xià tiān hěn cháo shī mēn rè
Jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān cháo shī
潮湿.en: It is less humid today than it was yesterday.

提问.zh: 提问对他来说是很羞耻的事。
提问.pinyin: Tí wèn duì tā lái shuō shì hěn xiū chǐ de shì
提问.en: He is ashamed to ask questions.
提问.es: A él le da vergüenza preguntar.

提问.pinyin: Wǒ shì zhe yòng fǎ yǔ tí wèn
提问.en: I am trying to ask my questions in French.
提问.es: Estoy tratando de plantear mis preguntas en francés.

提问.zh: 你真的需要提问题来知道答案吗？
提问.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn de xū yào tí wèn tí lái zhī dào dá àn ma
提问.en: Do you really need to ask the question to know the answer?
提问.es: ¿Realmente necesitas preguntar para saber la respuesta?

提问.pinyin: Nán hái men zài tí wèn

概念.zh: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。
概念.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè ge wǎng zhàn de gài niàn fēi cháng hǎo
概念.en: I really like the concept of this website.
概念.es: Realmente me agrada el concepto de este sitio web.

概念.zh: 关于这个我几乎没什么概念。
概念.pinyin: Guān yú zhè ge wǒ jī hū méi shén me gài niàn
概念.en: I know almost nothing about it.
概念.es: No sé casi nada de eso.

概念.pinyin: Wǒ míng bai zhè gài niàn

概念.zh: 我觉得你还没完全理解这个概念。
概念.pinyin: Wǒ jué de nǐ hái méi wán quán lǐ jiě zhè ge gài niàn
概念.en: I don't think you quite grasp the idea.

召开.zh: 委员会一个月召开两次。
召开.pinyin: Wěi yuán huì yī ge yuè zhào kāi liǎng cì
召开.en: The committee meets twice a month.
召开.es: El comité se reúne dos veces al mes.

召开.pinyin: Huì yì jiāng zài xià zhōu rì zhào kāi
召开.en: The meeting will take place next Sunday.
召开.es: La reunión se dará a lugar el próximo domingo.

召开.zh: 那么首先我们应该召开一次家庭会议。
召开.pinyin: Nà me shǒu xiān wǒ men yīng gāi zhào kāi yī cì jiā tíng huì yì
召开.en: In that case we should start by having a family meeting.

咨询.pinyin: Nǐ yīng gāi zī xún nǐ de yī shēng
Yóu kè zī xún chǔ zài nǎ lǐ
咨询.en: Where is the tourist information office?
咨询.es: ¿Dónde está la oficina de información turística?

咨询.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zī xún diǎnr shì qing
咨询.en: I'd like some advice on something.

咨询.zh: 好的，您想咨询什么事情？
咨询.pinyin: Hǎo de nín xiǎng zī xún shén me shì qíng
咨询.en: OK, what would you like advice on?

称赞.pinyin: Tā jí lì chēng zàn le wǒ
称赞.en: He praised me to the skies.

称赞.zh: 不管我怎么称赞他们，都不会过分。
称赞.pinyin: Bù guǎn wǒ zěn me chēng zàn tā men dōu bù huì guò fèn
称赞.en: I cannot praise them too highly.

称赞.zh: 马克是如此的诚实所以每个人都称赞他。
称赞.pinyin: Mǎ kè shì rú cǐ de chéng shí suǒ yǐ měi ge rén dōu chēng zàn tā
称赞.en: Mark is so honest that everyone praises him for it.

时刻.zh: 我们的方案在最后的时刻失败了。
时刻.pinyin: Wǒ men de fāng àn zài zuì hòu de shí kè shī bài le
时刻.en: Our plans fell through at the last minute.

时刻.pinyin: Zhè shì yī ge wěi dà de shí kè

时刻.zh: 这不过是他在谈判最后时刻尽可能最大化利润的尝试。
时刻.pinyin: Zhè bu guo shì tā zài tán pàn zuì hòu shí kè jǐn kě néng zuì dà huà lì rùn de cháng shì
时刻.en: It's just an attempt on his part to maximize profits, as much as possible, in the last moments of negotiations.

粮食.zh: 他们想栽培新品种的米来增加粮食生产。
粮食.pinyin: Tā men xiǎng zāi péi xīn pǐn zhǒng de mǐ lái zēng jiā liáng shi shēng chǎn
粮食.en: They want to increase food production by growing new kinds of rice.

粮食.pinyin: Liáng shi gōng yìng shí fēn chōng zú
粮食.en: There is an abundant supply of foodstuffs.

观念.zh: 无色的绿色的观念疯狂地睡觉。
观念.pinyin: Wú sè de lǜ sè de guān niàn fēng kuáng de shuì jiào
观念.es: Ideas verdes sin color duermen furiosamente.

观念.zh: 很多人觉得有教才有学，但其实这个观念是错的。
观念.pinyin: Hěn duō rén jué de yǒu jiāo cái yǒu xué dàn qí shí zhè ge guān niàn shì cuò de
观念.en: One of the great superstitions about education is that learning is the result of teaching.

观念.zh: 这是因为日本人和美国人对礼貌的观念有所不同。
观念.pinyin: Zhè shì yīn wèi rì běn rén hé měi guó rén duì lǐ mào de guān niàn yǒu suǒ bù tóng
观念.en: This is because of the difference between Japanese politeness and American politeness.

催.zh: 蟋蟀的叫声与蛙鸣催我入眠。
催.pinyin: Xī shuài de jiào shēng yǔ wā míng cuī wǒ rù mián
催.en: The sound of crickets chirping and frogs croaking lulls me to sleep.

催.pinyin: Xī liú chán chán cuī wǒ rù mián
催.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

催.zh: 慧如那个简报档还没传喔？客户在催。
催.pinyin: Huì rú nà ge jiǎn bào dǎng hái méi chuán ō kè hù zài cuī
催.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.

舍不得.zh: 我们的老板就连给我们涨一点工资都舍不得。
舍不得.pinyin: Wǒ men de lǎo bǎn jiù lián gěi wǒ men zhǎng yī diǎn gōng zī dōu shě bu de
舍不得.en: Our boss begrudged us even a small raise in pay.

舍不得.zh: 我在这里有家人，离开时会很舍不得他们。
舍不得.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè lǐ yǒu jiā rén lí kāi shí huì hěn shě bu de tā men
舍不得.en: I have family here that I'll be sad to leave behind.

集体.pinyin: Rì běn rén xǐ huan jí tǐ lǚ yóu
集体.en: The Japanese like to travel in groups.
集体.es: A los japoneses les gusta viajar en grupo.

集体.zh: 他在利用集体的名义，为自己谋利。
集体.pinyin: Tā zài lì yòng jí tǐ de míng yì wèi zì jǐ móu lì
集体.en: He is making use of the collective's name for his own profit.

集体.zh: 不要把个人行为上升到集体。
集体.pinyin: Bù yào bǎ gè rén xíng wéi shàng shēng dào jí tǐ
集体.en: Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.

提议.pinyin: Tā jù jué le wǒ de tí yì

提议.zh: 我提议我们在那里再待一天。
提议.pinyin: Wǒ tí yì wǒ men zài nà li zài dāi yī tiān
提议.en: I suggested that we should stay there another day.
提议.es: Sugerí que debíamos quedarnos allí otro día más.

提议.zh: 你应该拒绝他的提议的。
提议.pinyin: Nǐ yīng gāi jù jué tā de tí yì de
提议.en: You should have refused his offer.

提议.zh: 我们很高兴接受你的提议。
提议.pinyin: Wǒ men hěn gāo xìng jiē shòu nǐ de tí yì

罢工.zh: 我们罢工是因为公司没有改善我们的工资。
罢工.pinyin: Wǒ men bà gōng shì yīn wèi gōng sī méi yǒu gǎi shàn wǒ men de gōng zī
罢工.en: The reason we're on strike is that the company hasn't improved our wages.
罢工.es: Estamos de huelga porque la empresa no nos aumentó el sueldo.

罢工.zh: 「他们又要罢工了吗？」「恐怕是的。」
罢工.pinyin: Tā men yòu yào bà gōng le ma kǒng pà shì de
罢工.en: "Will they go on strike again?" "I'm afraid so."
罢工.es: "¿Van a hacer huelga de nuevo?" "Me temo que si".

罢工.zh: 我们罢工之所以是因为公司没有涨我们的工资。
罢工.pinyin: Wǒ men bà gōng zhī suǒ yǐ shì yīn wèi gōng sī méi yǒu zhǎng wǒ men de gōng zī
罢工.en: The reason we're on strike is that the company hasn't improved our wages.
罢工.es: Estamos de huelga porque la empresa no nos aumentó el sueldo.

艰难.zh: 这个月我过得有点艰难。
艰难.pinyin: Zhè ge yuè wǒ guò dé yǒu diǎn jiān nán
艰难.en: This month was kind of difficult.
艰难.es: Este mes ha sido algo difícil.

艰难.pinyin: Zhè shì gè hěn jiān nán de dòu zhēng

艰难.zh: 我想让她干这项艰难的工作。

太阳穴.pinyin: Tài yáng xué dùn dùn de tòng yì shí sì hū bèi lǒng zhào shàng le yī céng báo báo de wù ǎi
太阳穴.en: I have a dull pain in my temples and my mind feels like its covered with a thin layer of fog.

失物招领.zh: 离这里最近的失物招领处在哪里？
失物招领.pinyin: Lí zhè lǐ zuì jìn de shī wù zhāo lǐng chǔ zài nǎ lǐ
失物招领.en: Where is the nearest lost and found?
失物招领.es: ¿Dónde está la oficina de objetos perdidos más cercana?

失物招领.pinyin: Shī wù zhāo lǐng chǔ zài nǎr
失物招领.en: Where is the lost and found?

寿喜烧.pinyin: Wǒ zuì ài chī shòu xǐ shāo le
寿喜烧.en: I love to eat Sukiyaki most of all!

幌子.zh: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。
幌子.pinyin: Tā dá zhe jiàn wǒ de huǎng zi lái le wǒ jiā
幌子.en: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
幌子.es: Él vino a casa con el pretexto de verme.

年幼.zh: 约翰是七口之家中最年幼的，是父母的心头肉。
年幼.pinyin: Yuē hàn shì qī kǒu zhī jiā zhōng zuì nián yòu de shì fù mǔ de xīn tóu ròu
年幼.en: John, who is the youngest in a family of seven, is the apple of his parents' eyes.

年幼.zh: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。
年幼.pinyin: Dà bù fen guān zhòng shì nián yòu de ér tóng
年幼.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.

换工.pinyin: Wǒ de huàn gōng fú le
换工.en: I have to change into my work clothes.
换工.es: Me tengo que poner mi ropa de trabajo.

换工.zh: 好久不见。听说你又换工作了？
换工.pinyin: Hǎo jiǔ bu jiàn tīng shuō nǐ yòu huàn gōng zuō le
换工.en: Long time, no see. I hear that you've changed your job again.

撬开.zh: 汤姆撬开地板，寻找隐藏的金币。
撬开.pinyin: Tāng mǔ qiào kāi dì bǎn xún zhǎo yǐn cáng de jīn bì
撬开.en: Tom pried up the floorboards looking for the hidden gold coins.

撬开.zh: 他们试图用一根铁棒撬开锁。
撬开.pinyin: Tā men shì tú yòng yī gēn tiě bàng qiào kāi suǒ
撬开.en: They tried to use an iron bar to pry open the lock.

敬.zh: 事故发生时，敬勿使用电梯，请使用楼梯。
敬.pinyin: Shì gù fā shēng shí jìng wù shǐ yòng diàn tī qǐng shǐ yòng lóu tī
敬.en: In an emergency, use the stairway, not the elevator.
敬.es: En caso de emergencia, usa las escaleras, no el ascensor.

敬.zh: 幼儿园的老师告诉小朋友们要互敬互爱。
敬.pinyin: Yòu ér yuán de lǎo shī gào su xiǎo péng yǒu men yào hù jìng hù ài
敬.en: The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.

昏昏沉沉.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jué hūn hūn chén chén de
Nǐ kàn qǐ lai hūn hūn chén chén
昏昏沉沉.en: You looked like you were dizzy.

有一次.zh: 有一次，我在树里迷路了。
有一次.pinyin: Yǒu yī cì wǒ zài shù lǐ mí lù le
有一次.en: Once, I got lost inside a tree.
有一次.es: Una vez me perdí dentro de un árbol.

有一次.zh: 毕竟，这家伙有一次想杀我爸。
有一次.pinyin: Bì jìng zhè jiā huo yǒu yī cì xiǎng shā wǒ bà
有一次.en: After all, this is a guy that tried to kill my dad at one time.

柳暗花明.zh: 山穷水尽疑无路，柳暗花明又一村。
柳暗花明.pinyin: Shān qióng shuǐ jìn yí wú lù liǔ àn huā míng yòu yī cūn
柳暗花明.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.
柳暗花明.es: No hay mal que por bien no venga.

源于.zh: 所有的罪恶源于金钱的不足
源于.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu de zuì è yuán yú jīn qián de bù zú
源于.en: The lack of money is the root of all evil.
源于.es: La falta de dinero es la raíz de todo mal.

源于.zh: 我的建议源于我的经验。
源于.pinyin: Wǒ de jiàn yì yuán yú wǒ de jīng yàn
源于.en: My advice is predicated on my experience.

溪流.pinyin: Xī liú chán chán cuī wǒ rù mián
溪流.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

溪流.pinyin: Tā zuò zài xī liú páng biān
溪流.en: He sat next to the stream.

炒饭.zh: 我吃了炒饭，也喝了啤酒。
炒饭.pinyin: Wǒ chī le chǎo fàn yě hē le pí jiǔ
炒饭.en: I ate fried rice and drank some beer.
炒饭.es: Comí arroz frito y bebí algo de cerveza.

烈酒.pinyin: Fù qīn bù hē liè jiǔ

琐碎.zh: 他们的烦恼是由一件琐碎的事而起的。
琐碎.pinyin: Tā men de fán nǎo shì yóu yī jiàn suǒ suì de shì ér qǐ de
琐碎.en: Their trouble stems from a trifling matter.

电话簿.pinyin: Diàn huà bù zài nǎ lǐ
Wǒ néng kàn kan diàn huà bù ma
电话簿.en: May I see the telephone directory?

盒饭.zh: 今天没有空做晚饭，所以我去买了盒饭。
盒饭.pinyin: Jīn tiān méi yǒu kōng zuò wǎn fàn suǒ yǐ wǒ qù mǎi le hé fàn
盒饭.en: I didn't have time to cook dinner tonight, so I went out and bought a box meal.

空腹.pinyin: Nǐ yóu qí bù gāi kōng fù hē jiǔ
空腹.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
空腹.es: No debes tomar, sobre todo con el estómago vacío.

终归.pinyin: Tàn xún de rén zhōng guī néng zhǎo dào

罪魁祸首.zh: 我们都不认为他是事故的罪魁祸首。
罪魁祸首.pinyin: Wǒ men dōu bù rèn wéi tā shì shì gù de zuì kuí huò shǒu
罪魁祸首.en: None of us thought he was to blame for the accident.
罪魁祸首.es: Ninguno de nosotros pensaba que él fuera culpable del accidente.

罪魁祸首.zh: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
罪魁祸首.pinyin: Tīng qi lai hǎo xiàng tā shì zhè chǎng zāi nàn de zuì kuí huò shǒu
罪魁祸首.en: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.

羞愧.zh: 我对自己的行为感到羞愧。
羞愧.pinyin: Wǒ duì zì jǐ de xíng wéi gǎn dào xiū kuì
羞愧.en: I was ashamed of my behavior.

羞愧.zh: 他不因贫穷而感到羞愧。
羞愧.pinyin: Tā bù yīn pín qióng ér gǎn dào xiū kuì
羞愧.en: He is not ashamed of being poor.
羞愧.es: Él no se avergüenza de ser pobre.

行走.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan dú zì xíng zǒu

调味品.pinyin: Jī è shì zuì hǎo de tiáo wèi pǐn
调味品.es: No hay mejor salsa que el hambre.

调味品.pinyin: Bīng xiāng zhuāng mǎn le tiáo wèi pǐn
调味品.en: The fridge is overloaded with condiments.

车臣.zh: 我的梦想是在格罗兹尼学习车臣语。
车臣.pinyin: Wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì zài gé luó zī ní xué xí chē chén yǔ
车臣.en: My dream is to study Chechen in Grozny.

车臣.pinyin: Chē chén rén qīng xiàng dú lì

驶离.zh: 汽笛声响起，船开始慢慢地驶离港口。
驶离.pinyin: Qì dí shēng xiǎng qǐ chuán kāi shǐ màn màn de shǐ lí gǎng kǒu
驶离.en: A whistle blew, and the boat slowly began to pull out of port.
驶离.es: Un silbato sonó y el bote comenzó a irse lentamente del puerto.

鱼缸.zh: 我需要往我的鱼缸里加水。
鱼缸.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào wǎng wǒ de yú gāng lǐ jiā shuǐ
鱼缸.en: I needed to add water to my aquarium.

鱼缸.zh: 人是不是就像鱼缸中的金鱼一样？
鱼缸.pinyin: Rén shì bu shì jiù xiàng yú gāng zhòng dì jīn yú yī yàng
鱼缸.en: Are humans like goldfish in a fishbowl?

一五一十.zh: 他把他在非洲的所见所闻一五一十地告诉了我们。
一五一十.pinyin: Tā bǎ tā zài fēi zhōu de suǒ jiàn suǒ wén yī wǔ yī shí de gào su le wǒ men
一五一十.en: He gave us a detailed account of his experiences in Africa.
一五一十.es: Él nos dio una descripción detallada de sus experiencias en África.

不加思索.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bù jiā sī suǒ de xíng dòng

业余爱好者.zh: 她称自己为业余爱好者。
业余爱好者.pinyin: Tā chēng zì jǐ wèi yè yú ài hào zhě

业绩.zh: 假期期间销售业绩畅旺，但之后就下滑了。
业绩.pinyin: Jià qī qī jiān xiāo shòu yè jì chàng wàng dàn zhī hòu jiù xià huá le
业绩.en: Sales were brisk during the holiday season but have dropped off since.

中央情报局.zh: 你知道中央情报局的什么？
中央情报局.pinyin: Nǐ zhī dào zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de shén me
中央情报局.en: What do you know about the CIA?

主机板.zh: 主机板的包装盒在哪里？
主机板.pinyin: Zhǔ jī bǎn de bāo zhuāng hé zài nǎ lǐ
主机板.en: Where's the box the motherboard came in?

人墙.zh: 当里奥梅西射门时，球员们筑起一道人墙。
人墙.pinyin: Dāng lǐ ào méi xī shè mén shí qiú yuán men zhù qǐ yī dào rén qiáng
人墙.en: The players made a wall as Lionel Messi went to shoot.

人龙.zh: 买票的人龙竟然那么长！
人龙.pinyin: Mǎi piào de rén lóng jìng rán nà me cháng
人龙.en: The queue for buying tickets was unbelievably long.
人龙.es: La cola para comprar los billetes era increíblemente larga.
